"/><div class="body"><div class="event-date">Sunday, October 11</div><h3>Waterford’s Trunk or Treat &amp; Car Show</h3><p class="event-time">4:00 PM – 7:00 PM</p><p>Bin Street · 5100 Dixie Hwy, Waterford</p><p>Candy, food trucks, cars and family fun — a community event Kelly helped organize long before the campaign became the focus.</p></div></article></div><div class="event-note"><strong>These are conversations, not speeches.</strong> Kelly wants people to be able to ask what matters to them and tell her what they want her to understand about Waterford Schools.</div></div></section><section class="cream" id="community"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-kicker">Community</div><h2>Showing up for Waterford didn’t start with a campaign.</h2><p>Before there were campaign signs, there were Santa rides, Easter Bunny visits, parades, community events and years of helping families put down roots in Waterford.</p><div class="story-grid"><article class="story-card"><img alt="Santa through Waterford" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
